description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wearable app that syncs calendar events with a wearable device via GoogleApiClient and DataApi, handling permissions and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing GoogleApiClient connection, permissions, and data sync with wearable device.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not resolving errors.

methods.name: onGetEventsClicked
methods.description: Checks calendar and contacts permissions, requests if needed, or initiates calendar data push.

methods.name: requestCalendarAndContactPermissions
methods.description: Requests calendar and contacts permissions, showing rationale if necessary.

methods.name: pushCalendarToWear
methods.description: Starts service to query calendar data.

methods.name: onDeleteEventsClicked
methods.description: Deletes calendar data items from wearable device.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Deletes specified data items from GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts, tries resolution if available.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from resolution activity, attempts reconnect if successful.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles result of permission requests, proceeds if granted.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends messages to log TextView and scrolls to bottom.
